tests.name: AgriculturaMercadoIntegrationPlayModeTests.InternationalAircraftPurchaseRejectsInsufficientFundsThenShipsAndRegistersAtBuyerAirport
tests.verification: Current-assembly end-to-end purchase, maritime freight, pending destination, save/restore, and single aircraft registration at the buyer airport.

initialFailureAndResolution.failure: After the intermediate change treated producerInstanceId <= 0 as unowned, the physical shipyard order disappeared during Cleanup(Time.time + 181).
initialFailureAndResolution.resolution: ProducerInstanceId == 0 is now the sole no-owner sentinel. Nonzero negative Unity instance IDs are treated as valid producer ownership. Scheduler Queued -> producer Queued handoff is also supported.

warningNotes: Asset catalog refresh in the PlayMode fixture reports missing script references.
The test shipyard and airport fixtures intentionally have no authored slots/parking.
The existing content audit reports missing weapon or damage-system setup for several catalog items.

marketAirportReview.evidence: The end-to-end market purchase/freight/save-restore test passed against the current assembly. SistemaLogisticaMercado calls RegistrarAeronaveRecebida; the aircraft is registered at the buyer airport with buyer team and return-base references.

remainingScope: This validation closes the production-reservation TTL defect only. The broader Phase A integration, economy, performance, and multi-country audit remains open.
